plan.title: Agent MCP and bots (W-INT0): Shared Overdeck skill text
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The PAN-4927 epic ships four outside-bot plugins (Hermes, OpenClaw, Grok Build, Grok Bot). Each bundles a skill that tells the bot what Overdeck is, which tools to call and which safety rules to follow. Four hand-written skills would drift apart, and integrations/ does not exist yet.
narratives.Proposal: Write the skill once in integrations/shared/SKILL.md (exact text in the PRD section 'The skill text'), add integrations/shared/sync-skill.mjs that copies it byte-for-byte to integrations/<platform>/skills/overdeck/SKILL.md for hermes, openclaw, grok-build and grok-bot and, with --check, exits 1 when a copy differs or is missing. Commit the four generated copies, guard them with tests/unit/integrations/sync-skill.test.ts (runs in the existing CI vitest shards), and add integrations/README.md and integrations/LICENSE (byte copy of the root MIT LICENSE).
narratives.NonGoals:
- No edit to .github/workflows/ (the integrations CI job is W-CI1)
- No plugin manifest, plugin code, per-package README, PUBLISHING.md, CHANGELOG.md or per-package LICENSE (W-INT1 to W-INT4)
- No change to src/lib/mcp/ tools or their descriptions
- No change to package.json files or Bun workspaces; integrations/ is not part of @overdeck/core
- No generated-file banner in the skill or its copies, and no frontmatter keys beyond single-line name and description
- No edit to the epic PRD .pan/drafts/pan-4927.md
- No npm dependency for the sync script; Node built-ins only
- Nothing is published to any registry

autoDecisions.summary: The skill names only the ten MCP tools that exist today (list_machines, list_conversations, search_conversations, read_conversation, send_message, start_conversation, start_worker, list_pending_input, answer_question, answer_permission), describes later tools by capability, and says the client's tool list is authoritative.
autoDecisions.rationale: W-INT0 has no dependency in the epic, so it can land before W-DEL1, W-SCHED1, W-APPR1 and W-PR1 add their tools; naming tools that do not exist would mislead a bot.

autoDecisions.summary: The epic's 'never poll, use the wait tools' rule is rephrased as: do not call a read tool in a loop; when a tool answer has a next field, call that tool with those arguments.
autoDecisions.rationale: Every wait tool in the epic is audience 'agent', so a bot never sees one; the rephrased rule is true for every caller.

autoDecisions.summary: Frontmatter is single-line name and description only.
autoDecisions.rationale: The same bytes go to four loaders; OpenClaw's embedded parser reads single-line keys only and every loader requires exactly these two keys.

autoDecisions.summary: The sync script takes --root <dir> to run against a temp fixture.
autoDecisions.rationale: Lets the test prove the fail path without touching the real copies; same pattern as scripts/lint-dist-externals.mjs and its test.

autoDecisions.summary: A missing copy counts as drift (exit 1, 'is missing'); bad usage exits 2.
autoDecisions.rationale: AC-24 requires --check to fail whenever a copy does not match, and a missing copy cannot match.

metadata.sizeJustification: Four small items in one new directory plus one new test file; one subsystem (integrations).

items.title: Write integrations/shared/SKILL.md with the exact skill text from the PRD

expected_outputs: first four lines are ---, name: overdeck, a description: line, ---
wc reports at most 100 lines and at most 6000 bytes (the PRD text is 76 lines, 3622 bytes)

narrative.Action: Create integrations/shared/SKILL.md containing exactly the text between the four-backtick fences in the PRD section 'The skill text' (.pan/drafts/pan-4952.md), ending with one newline, LF line endings. Do not reword, trim, add frontmatter keys, add a banner, or add a references/ folder.

items.title: Given the new file, when its first four lines are read, then they are '---', 'name: overdeck', a line starting 'description: Watch and steer Overdeck', and '---'
The file contains the headings '## Tool names and access', '## Tool groups' and '## Safety rules', and the safety section has six numbered rules matching the PRD text byte-for-byte
When wc -l -c runs on the file, then it prints at most 100 lines and at most 6000 bytes
Add integrations/shared/sync-skill.mjs with fixture tests

narrative.Action: Write integrations/shared/sync-skill.mjs to the PRD section 'The sync script contract' (ES module, Node built-ins only, top-level await, process.exitCode; PLATFORMS = hermes, openclaw, grok-build, grok-bot; --check and --root <dir>; exit 0/1/2 and the exact messages listed there; Buffer.equals comparison; mkdir recursive before each write). chmod +x it. Write tests/unit/integrations/sync-skill.test.ts per PRD W-2 steps 2-3: spawnSync(process.execPath, [SCRIPT, ...args]) against mkdtemp fixture roots, five tests in describe('sync-skill.mjs (fixture root)'): writes four byte-identical copies; check passes after sync; check fails and names only the edited openclaw copy and leaves it unmodified; check fails on a deleted grok-bot copy with 'is missing'; unknown flag exits 2 with 'usage:'. Clean every fixture root in afterEach.

items.title: Given a fixture root holding only integrations/shared/SKILL.md, when 'node sync-skill.mjs --root <root>' runs, then it exits 0, prints 'skill copies: 4 updated, 0 unchanged' and creates the four copies byte-identical to the source

Given a synced fixture root with one appended byte in the openclaw copy, when '--check --root <root>' runs, then it exits 1, stderr names integrations/openclaw/skills/overdeck/SKILL.md as differing and no other copy, and the edited copy is unchanged afterwards
Given a synced fixture root with the grok-bot copy deleted, when '--check --root <root>' runs, then it exits 1 and stderr contains 'integrations/grok-bot/skills/overdeck/SKILL.md is missing'
When the script runs with an unknown flag, then it exits 2 and stderr contains 'usage:'
The script imports only node: built-in modules (grep -E "from '" integrations/shared/sync-skill.mjs shows only node: specifiers)
Generate and commit the four skill copies with a real-repo guard test

expected_outputs: prints '✓ 4 skill copies match integrations/shared/SKILL.md' and exits 0

narrative.Action: From the repo root run 'node integrations/shared/sync-skill.mjs' and commit the four generated copies unchanged. Extend tests/unit/integrations/sync-skill.test.ts with describe('integrations/ in this repository') holding three tests (PRD W-3 step 2): run(['--check']) with no --root exits 0; the shared skill's first four lines are '---', 'name: overdeck', a 'description: ' line with no further ': ', '---'; the shared skill is at most 100 lines and 6000 bytes. Then prove the fail half of AC-24 by hand: append a byte to one copy, confirm --check exits 1, and restore it by re-running the sync script (never git checkout or git stash). git status --short integrations/ must be clean before committing.

items.title: Given the committed tree, when 'node integrations/shared/sync-skill.mjs --check' runs from the repo root, then it exits 0 and prints '✓ 4 skill copies match integrations/shared/SKILL.md'
Given one committed copy with an appended byte, when --check runs, then it exits 1 and names that copy; re-running the sync script restores it and --check exits 0 again
cmp integrations/shared/SKILL.md integrations/<platform>/skills/overdeck/SKILL.md exits 0 for each of hermes, openclaw, grok-build and grok-bot
When npx vitest run tests/unit/integrations/sync-skill.test.ts runs, then it prints 8 passed tests, including the three real-repository tests
Add integrations/README.md and integrations/LICENSE

narrative.Action: Run 'cp LICENSE integrations/LICENSE' (no edits). Write integrations/README.md with exactly the content between the four-backtick fences in PRD W-4 step 2: the directory table (hermes, openclaw, grok-build, grok-bot, shared), 'The shared skill' section (edit only shared/SKILL.md, run node integrations/shared/sync-skill.mjs, never edit a copy, --check exits 1 on drift and tests/unit/integrations/sync-skill.test.ts runs it in CI, single-line frontmatter and the 100-line/6000-byte budget), and 'Publishing' (operator-approved step, PAN-4927 D-5).

items.title: cmp LICENSE integrations/LICENSE exits 0 (byte copy of the root MIT license)
integrations/README.md renders a table naming the hermes/, openclaw/, grok-build/, grok-bot/ and shared/ directories
integrations/README.md contains 'shared/SKILL.md' as the only file to edit, and contains both 'node integrations/shared/sync-skill.mjs' and its '--check' form
integrations/README.md contains a Publishing section saying publishing is a separate operator-approved step, citing PAN-4927 decision D-5
